projects.title: Link.Lite - Personal Bio Link Platform
projects.description: A Linktree-like web app that lets users create a single customizable profile page to share multiple links, manage them from a dashboard, and track basic engagement. Built with secure authentication and scalable backend architecture.

projects.title: Community Forum - Social Discussion Platform
projects.description: A community-driven forum platform for posting topics, discussions, and comments with moderation features to promote healthy and respectful conversations. Designed as a foundation for a larger mission-driven social network.

projects.title: Real-Time Tracker
projects.description: A real-time tracking system that captures and displays live location data of users or devices on an interactive map, enabling instant monitoring, movement history, and status updates with low latency communication.
